title: 原生二进制发布的构建与许可证来源证明
summary: 当发布产物包含受具体 build flags、upstream revision 或许可证组合影响的原生组件时，发布身份必须记录这些构建事实，避免同一版本标签下静默切换能力或许可证语义。
rules: Record exact upstream revision for distributed native components.
Record relevant build flags/configuration that change codec/features/license obligations.
Ship or link required license texts and corresponding source/build instructions.
Do not silently switch materially different native bundles under the same binary/release identity.
Build provenance SHOULD be inspectable independently from marketing/version labels.

provenance.note: Rule 20 GPL build configuration and distributed Android artifact.
